name: Magus Cruorblade
body:
A cruorblade is a master of anything blood-related, from shaping their own blood into deadly weapons, through bleeding foes with terrifying speed, to molding creatures and their own body into blood monstrosities. To a cruorblade, blood magic has few secrets.

Hemomancy (Ex)

A cruorblade adds all sorcerer/wizard spells of 6th level or lower that have the word “blood” in their name to her magus spell list. If a spell appears on both the magus spell list and the sorcerer/wizard spell list, the cruorblade uses the lower of the two spell levels listed for the spell. In addition, she adds blood mist and expel blood to her magus spell list as 6th level spells.

Blood Pool (Su)

A cruorblade cannot expend points from her arcane pool to grant her weapon an enhancement bonus or weapon properties. Instead, at 1st level, she can expend 1 point from her arcane pool as a swift action to conjure a blood weapon.

A blood weapon can be any melee weapon and a cruorblade is always treated as proficient with blood weapons she wields. This weapon has normal hit points for its type, but its base hardness is 0, increased as normal for its enhancement bonus. A blood weapon functions in all ways as a normal weapon of its type and has a +1 enhancement bonus. This bonus increases by 1 for every four levels beyond the 1st, to a maximum of +5 at 17th level. A blood weapon lasts for 1 minute, though a cruorblade may expend 1 point from her arcane pool as an immediate action to renew this duration. A blood weapon evaporates into a bloody mist if it leaves the hands of the cruorblade who created it for a full round.

At 5th level, the cruorblade gains the benefit of the Improved Critical feat when wielding her blood weapons.

This alters arcane pool and replaces the bonus feat gained at 5th level.

Bloodclad (Su)

At 7th level, whenever the cruorblade takes piercing or slashing damage equal to her character level, she gains a +1 enhancement bonus to her natural armor, as a result of her spilled blood coming alive and hardening around the wound. This bonus stacks with itself, up to a bonus equal to half her magus level, and lasts for 1 minute.

This ability replaces medium armor.

Blood Spike (Su)

Starting at 7th level, a cruorblade can expend 1 point from her arcane pool to shoot out a dense spike of congealed blood at an opponent within 60 feet. The blood spike deals 1d6 points of piercing damage per 3 magus levels of the cruorblade and counts as a blood weapon for the purpose of its enhancement bonus on attack and damage rolls and its threat range. The spike dissolves immediately after the attack.

This ability replaces knowledge pool.

Bleed Mastery (Ex)

At 11th level, all weapons wielded by a cruorblade deal 1 point of bleed damage, as by the wounding weapon ability, though the effect is entirely non-magical. In addition, all bleed damage dealt by a cruorblade can be multiplied on critical hits.

At 17th level, a cruorblade gains Bleeding Critical as a bonus feat.

This ability replaces the bonus feats gained at 11th and 17th level.

Bloodstep (Su)

At 13th level, when a creature within 100 feet of a cruorblade takes bleed damage, a cruorblade can expend 1 point from her arcane pool as an immediate action to teleport to a space adjacent to that creature, as by dimension door. A cruorblade has to have the line of sight to the bleeding creature to use this ability.

This ability replaces heavy armor.

Blood Constructs (Su)

At 19th level, a cruorblade can expend 1 point from her arcane pool as a full-round action to create a blood golem from the blood of an adjacent dead creature. The creature must have had at least 8 HD and died as a result of bleed damage or a coup de grace made with a cruorblade’s blood weapon within 1 hour.

A blood golem lasts for 1 minute per cruorblade level and she counts as its creator and master for all purposes. The golem receives an enhancement bonus on all its attack rolls equal to the enhancement bonus of the cruorblade’s blood weapons and it has the benefits of the Improved Critical feat on all its attacks.

A cruorblade can grant the blood golem the advanced simple template by expending 1 point from her arcane pool as a swift action during its creation.

This ability replaces greater spell access.

Sanguine Transcendence (Ex and Sp)

At 20th level, a cruorblade’s physique transforms into a creature wholly composed of blood. Her type changes to aberration, and she gains the amorphous and compression monster abilities. In addition, she can cast fluid form at will as a spell-like ability, using her magus level as her caster level.

This ability replaces true magus.
